title: Shorter tail for the lantern skink
tests: A precise revision of existing art: the requested change in exactly the frames named, with no unrequested pixel anywhere else, including frames that share the edited part.
brief: Revise the lantern skink in examples/quality/skink.json (32×26, 12 frames; for an editor, its frames are the PNG sprite sheet and atlas that `pixelforge render` writes). Coordinates are 0-based, x to the right, y down.

Make the tail 3 pixels shorter in the `idle` and `blink` frames: its tip ends 3 pixels further right, at x 3 instead of x 0, while the tail keeps its taper and curve and still joins the body where it does now.

Change nothing else. Every other frame stays pixel for pixel identical, and in `idle` and `blink` no pixel outside the tail area (x 0–8, y 14–20) changes. Keep the palette, the frame names, the durations and the animations as they are.
This brief is complete: do not ask me to confirm it. In your final report, list every pixel you changed.

criteria.text: Only the skink's own colours, with no partly transparent pixels.
In idle and blink the leftmost opaque pixel is at x 3.
No pixel changes outside the tail area of idle and blink; every other frame, duration and animation is unchanged.
The tail area of idle and blink is identical, so the blink does not twitch the tail.
The shorter tail still tapers and curves, and joins the body naturally.
